description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Virtual Network operations

checks: Virtual Network provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed
addressPrefixes match the requested CIDR range(s)
subnet addressPrefixes are within the VNet address space and non-overlapping
DNS servers and VNet peering connections match the requested configuration
Delete VNet/subnet operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
VNet deletion warns about all dependent resources (NICs, NSGs, peerings)
Subnet deletion checks for existing NIC attachments before proceeding
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Subnet creation with existing name returns appropriate error (not duplicate)
VNet peering creation checks for existing peering before creating duplicate
Delete operations on already-deleted VNets return success
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Address space and subnet CIDR ranges are documented
VNet peering state (Connected/Disconnected) and DNS configuration are logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
--address-prefixes and --subnet-prefixes are specified for VNet creation
--location parameter is specified for VNet creation
